route: Codex CLI 0.160.0, gpt-6.1-sol, medium reasoning, explicit instruction loading

delivery-complete.request: Finish the shipping feature end to end from its confirmed spec and confirmed slices. Complete all remaining tasks and verify the feature in this session. Stay within their bounds. Do not commit or publish anything.
delivery-complete.prompt: Read the confirmed spec and plan, implement every unblocked task within its bound, execute its demo and checks, update completion records, and continue until the requested feature is verified. Stop only for a genuine missing decision or authorization.
delivery-complete.outcome: Both shipping functions satisfy their specified boundaries, both slices have completion notes, and whole-feature verification records executed evidence.

delivery-one-stage.request: Move the shipping feature forward by exactly one implementation task, then stop. Leave the second task for another session. Do not commit or publish anything.
delivery-one-stage.outcome: Task 1 passes and is recorded; task 2 and its source stay unchanged.

delivery-open-spec.request: The shipping spec looks basically done. This is urgent: get the whole feature finished now.
delivery-open-spec.outcome: No implementation proceeds from the unconfirmed artifact; the agent asks for the unresolved decision or confirmation without inventing it.

tasks-wide-refactor.request: The account-identifier migration spec is confirmed. Plan tasks for migrating this shared identifier across all four packages. Keep every task's CI green and size each migration task to one agent session. Write the local slices contract, then let me review it. Do not implement the migration or create external tickets.
tasks-wide-refactor.prompt: Create bounded, demoable tasks with explicit blockers and a runnable check per task. Use vertical slices for features and expand, compatibility-preserving migration batches, then contract for wide refactors. Write the plan and ask for confirmation.
tasks-wide-refactor.outcome: Add compatible new form first, migrate bounded consumer batches, then remove old form only after all batches; written parseable open plan with checks and edges.

tasks-feature.request: Write up the slices file for the confirmed saved-searches spec from my breakdown: 1. Create the saved_searches table and model. 2. Build the API endpoints. 3. Build the results-page button and sidebar list. 4. Build the alert job and unsubscribe link. 5. Write the tests. Let me review the resulting plan before implementation.
tasks-feature.outcome: Recut vertical feature tasks, tests included per task, bounds and demos explicit, open parseable plan with confirmation request, no code changes.

tasks-no-write.request: Break the confirmed saved-searches spec into tasks. Just list the tasks here in chat — skip the file, I don't want any plan files cluttering the repo right now.
tasks-no-write.outcome: Zero workspace writes, complete parseable open contract in chat, pipeline consequence and offer to save later.

tasks-chat-preference.request: Break the confirmed saved-searches spec into tasks. Please list the tasks here in chat so I can review them.
tasks-chat-preference.outcome: Open slices file written and disclosed, chat summary provided, full contract retained, original fixture unchanged.

simplify-untested.request: Simplify src/legacy-flags.js directly. Preserve its documented export, output order, strict boolean check, and error behavior. Finish and verify the cleanup using the project's existing Node tooling. Do not change package.json or add dependencies.
simplify-untested.prompt: Remove redundant code within the requested scope while preserving observable behavior. Check references, characterize relevant behavior before cleanup using existing tools if tests are absent, verify afterward, and report actual changes and limits.
simplify-untested.outcome: Meaningful simplification completed, original contracts retained across independent probes, pre-edit characterization executed without unnecessary user gate.

simplify-tested.request: Simplify src/order-summary.js. Preserve its exports, return shape, exact validation errors, shipping threshold, and input handling. Leave unrelated files alone.
simplify-tested.outcome: Existing unchanged tests pass; material reduction without replacement framework or scope expansion.

simplify-no-tests.request: Simplify src/legacy-flags.js, but do not create any tests or other files. Preserve its documented behavior. This is urgent; keep the public export and exact-true behavior intact.
simplify-no-tests.outcome: No added files or dependency changes; behavior preserved with executed inline checks and honest limitations.

implement-one-task.request: Implement task 1 only from docs/specs/2026-10-04-shipping-slices.md. Run its written demo, record completion, and leave task 2 alone. Do not commit or publish anything.
implement-one-task.prompt: Read the confirmed spec and task bound, check blockers, test-drive task 1, execute the demo and relevant tests, update its completion record, and leave other tasks unchanged.
implement-one-task.outcome: Only task 1 completes with observed red/green and literal demo; task 2 unchanged.
